translations.en: With respect to foods, we do not already suppose the rare things to be in every way even more pleasant than the abundant ones.
translations.ta: உணவுகளைப் பொறுத்தவரை, அரிதானவை மிகுதியானவற்றை விட எல்லா வகையிலும் மேலும் இனிமையானவை என்று நாம் ஏற்கெனவே கருதவில்லை.

notes: Underdots appear under most letters and denote uncertain readings; the translation follows the letters as given without restoring or adding words. The negation ou-k with nomizomen is kept as a negative statement, and hedio ... ton dapsilon is kept as a comparative. Lunate sigma in spania is read as sigma. No square brackets or editorial question marks occur in the supplied text; the final middle dot is punctuation and is not read as a question mark.
